agent_prompt:
CONTEXT:
- Project: NorthGuard recurring-work intelligence. Tech: Python 3.11 + pytest. Runs on the backstop host. Input: FeatureDocs (US-025) + MinHash candidate pairs (US-026), both read-only.
- This is the reproducibility-critical stage. Embeddings are ALLOWED here precisely because they are pinned and deterministic (see DECISION-REGISTER R2/R3, AGENT-RULES NG-15).

TASK:
Implement US-027 (AF-703): cluster prompts that are about the same thing phrased differently — the headline case MinHash alone misses — using a PINNED local embedding model with cached vectors and a FIXED cosine threshold. Record model version + threshold on every cluster.

CREATE FILES: per manifest.create. Signatures exactly per specs/EP-07-recurring-work/APP-FUNCTIONS.md (AF-703).

RULES:
1. TDD first. Include: (a) two paraphrases of the same document cluster together even though MinHash did NOT pair them; (b) running the whole stage twice over the same input yields IDENTICAL cluster ids (NG-15 determinism test).
2. Determinism is mandatory: pin the model version (from env/config), disable sampling, cache vectors by sha256(redacted_text), fix the threshold. No wall-clock, no randomness (seed anything that needs seeding).
3. NG-10: never read an original value — only redacted text + pseudonyms already on the FeatureDocs.
4. NFR-04/NFR-05: the model is local and small; nothing leaves the host.
5. Cluster id is a deterministic function of sorted member ids (stable across runs).
6. record_model_provenance stamps every cluster with model_version + threshold so results are comparable only within a model version.
7. Do not modify features/, minhash/, or core/ (protected). Report the two determinism/paraphrase tests explicitly.
